sloka: निर्वृत्ते तु क्रतौ तस्मिन् हयमेधे महात्मनः ।प्रति गृह्य अमरा भागान् प्रतिजग्मुः यथा आगतम् ॥१-१८-१॥
transliteration: nirvṛtte tu kratau tasmin hayamedhe mahātmanaḥ ।prati gṛhya amarā bhāgān pratijagmuḥ yathā āgatam ॥1-18-1॥

translations.english: Completed by the magnanimous king (Dasaratha). The aswamedha and putreshti sacrifices, the devatas received their share of havis and returned to their respective abodes.
